content: {"items": [{"type": "obligation", "text": "The regulations shall permit the operator of a website or an online service to terminate service provided to a child whose parent has refused, under the regulations prescribed under paragraph (1)(B)(ii), to permit the operator's further use or maintenance in retrievable form, or future online collection, of personal information from that child.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The regulations", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null}, {"type": "obligation", "text": "Subject to sections 6503 and 6505 of this title, a violation of a regulation prescribed under subsection (a) shall be treated as a violation of a rule defining an unfair or deceptive act or prac tice prescribed under section 57a(a)(1)(B) of this title.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "shall be treated as a violation of a rule defining an unfair or deceptive act or prac tice prescribed under section 57a(a)(1)(B) of this title"}, {"type": "prohibition", "text": "No State or local government may impose any liability for commercial activities or actions by operators in interstate or foreign commerce in connection with an activity or action described in this chapter that is inconsistent with the treatment of those activities or actions under this section.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "State or local government", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null}, {"type": "reference", "text": "paragraph (1)(B)(ii)", "cited_instrument": "15 U.S.C. 6502(b)(1)(B)(ii)"}, {"type": "reference", "text": "sections 6503 and 6505 of this title", "cited_instrument": "15 U.S.C. 6503 and 6505"}, {"type": "reference", "text": "subsection (a)", "cited_instrument": "15 U.S.C. 6502(a)"}, {"type": "reference", "text": "section 57a(a)(1)(B) of this title", "cited_instrument": "15 U.S.C. 57a(a)(1)(B)"}, {"type": "reference", "text": "Pub. L. 105-277", "cited_instrument": "Pub. L. 105-277"}, {"type": "reference", "text": "section 1308 of Pub. L. 105-277", "cited_instrument": "Pub. L. 105-277, section 1308"}, {"type": "reference", "text": "section 6501 of this title", "cited_instrument": "15 U.S.C. 6501"}]}

{"items": [
{"type": "obligation", "text": "It is unlawful for an operator of a website or online service directed to children, or any operator that has actual knowledge that it is collecting personal information from a child, to collect personal information from a child in a manner that violates the regulations prescribed under subsection (b).", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "an operator of a website or online service directed to children, or any operator that has actual knowledge that it is collecting personal information from a child", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "in a manner that violates the regulations prescribed under subsection (b)"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Not later than 1 year after October 21, 1998, the Commission shall promulgate under section 553 of title 5 regulations that-", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the Commission", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "Not later than 1 year after October 21, 1998"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(A) require the operator of any website or online service directed to children that collects personal information from children or the operator of a website or online service that has actual knowledge that it is collecting personal information from a child-", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the Commission", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "Not later than 1 year after October 21, 1998"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(i) to provide notice on the website of what information is collected from children by the operator, how the operator uses such information, and the operator's disclosure practices for such information; and", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator of any website or online service directed to children", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(ii) to obtain verifiable parental consent for the collection, use, or disclosure of personal information from children;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator of any website or online service directed to children", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "verifiable parental consent"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(B) require the operator to provide, upon request of a parent under this subparagraph whose child has provided personal information to that website or online service, upon proper identification of that parent, to such parent-", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "upon request of a parent under this subparagraph whose child has provided personal information to that website or online service, upon proper identification of that parent"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(C) prohibit conditioning a child's participation in a game, the offering of a prize, or another activity on the child disclosing more personal information than is reasonably necessary to participate in such activity; and", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "the Commission", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(D) require the operator of such a website or online service to establish and maintain reasonable procedures to protect the confidentiality, security, and integrity of personal information collected from children.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator of such a website or online service", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "reasonable procedures"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The regulations shall provide that verifiable parental consent under paragraph (1)(A)(ii) is not required in the case of-", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the regulations", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "neither an operator of such a website or online service nor the operator's agent shall be held to be liable under any Federal or State law for any disclosure made in good faith and following reasonable procedures in responding to a re quest for disclosure of personal information under subsection (b)(1)(B)(iii) to the parent of a child.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "an operator of such a website or online service and the operator's agent", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "made in good faith and following reasonable procedures"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "section 553 of title 5", "cited_instrument": "5 U.S.C. 553"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "subsection (b)(1)(B)(iii)", "cited_instrument": "15 U.S.C. 6502(b)(1)(B)(iii)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "subsection (b)", "cited_instrument": "15 U.S.C. 6502(b)"}
]}
